prompt: A photograph from a webcam-style lens fixed on a bookshelf at the end of the attic, looking along the room at a single bed under a sloped ceiling in flat morning daylight. A skylight blows out to near white and the rest of the room is washed out and slightly soft. Brandon sits bolt upright in the bed, the duvet bunched at his waist, both palms flat on his own cheeks, eyes wide, brows high and mouth open in an astonished O. A mug and a crumpled hoodie sit on the floorboards by the bed. Thanks.
